short: Spectral amplification baseline for the energy window

statements.markdown: giving a cumulative baseline of $1.09\times 10^{12}$ on $481$ logical qubits
statements.note: The published ground-energy estimate is about $2.26\times10^{12}$ qubit–T, based on 51,510 walk steps at 9,535 Toffolis per step on 1,150 logical qubits. The manuscript’s adjusted baseline incorporates compilation improvements and the 0.1 Ha energy window, giving about $1.09\times10^{12}$ qubit–T on 481 logical qubits; these are reported estimates, not compiled baseline counts.

statements.markdown: Our baseline starts from the sum-of-squares spectral amplification estimate
statements.note: The gap in Eq. (21) runs from the sum-of-squares lower bound to an upper bound on the cutoff. For $x=E-E_{\mathrm{SOS}}=\Lambda(1+\cos\varphi)$, the slope has magnitude $\sqrt{x(2\Lambda-x)}$. This increases up to $x=\Lambda$, so the low-energy window bounds it by its value at the gap. In the doubled phase the slope is half as large.
